description: Patch-surface ownership manifest for the MainWindow extraction slices: each key is an owner module (in extraction-slice order) and each entry lists the app_gui names that module now owns for itself. A test patching one of these names through app_gui is a silent no-op for the owner's code, because the owner resolves the name from its own globals — such a patch must be repointed at the owner, or the name un-moved. Read by tests/test_app_gui_patch_surface.py, which enforces it and verifies every listed name still exists on its module, and by extraction-slice tooling that needs to know what has already been moved.

the_oracle.gui_render.note: Only the no-op-after-move name. The three class names must NOT be listed: MainWindow (still in app_gui) constructs RenderWorker, PreviewWorker and RenderProgressDialog from app_gui globals, so app_gui-level class patches remain live and legitimate.
